summary: RGPD Cookie Consent System fully tested - All 13 features working correctly. Cookie banner, customize modal, legal pages, and reset functionality all operational.
critical_code_review_comments: Cookie consent implementation follows RGPD best practices
localStorage key 'actoos_cookie_consent' properly stores version, preferences, and timestamp
Essential cookies toggle correctly disabled (always on)
Legal pages have proper structure with all required sections
context_for_next_testing_agent: RGPD Cookie Consent System is fully functional. Uses localStorage key 'actoos_cookie_consent' with version 1.0. Banner appears after 1 second delay on first visit. Four cookie categories: essential (always on, disabled toggle), analytics, marketing, preferences. Legal pages at /privacy, /terms, /cookies all working. Reset button on /cookies page clears consent and shows banner.
